item.title: [News] Meta to Launch Charm Device for Muse AI in December, Unveils New VR and Ray-Ban Glasses
item.description: Meta is expanding its hardware push beyond smart glasses with new AI and VR devices. According to Reuters, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg unveiled Meta Charm, a small handheld device designed for the company’s new Muse AI assistant. About the size of an Apple AirPods case, it features a roughly 2-inch touchscreen and built-in 5G connectivity. Meta said Charm is expected to ship in time for the holiday season in December.
